priorityList: --- Icy Veins Diabolist Rotation (Hero-Spec Specific) ---
Maintain Immolate at all times.
Cast Summon Infernal.
Cast Shadowburn whenever available.
Cast Soul Fire when available if below 4 shards.
Cast Chaos Bolt if you are about to cap Soul Shards.
Cast Infernal Bolt if below 4 Shards.
Cast Channel Demonfire whenever available.
Cast Conflagrate if you have 2 charges, possibly to hasten a long cast such as Chaos Bolt.
Cast Conflagrate to generate Soul Shards.
Cast Incinerate to generate Soul Shards.
--- WoWhead Diabolist Opener ---
Precast Soul Fire
Pop Summon Infernal as well as any potions, trinkets and racials
Cast Conflagrate to generate soul shards and Backdraft stacks
Generate and spend as many soul shards as possible during your cooldowns. Try spend as many Backdraft stacks on casting Chaos Bolt as possible.
Proceed onto the normal priority list
--- WoWhead Diabolist Rotation ---
Maintain Immolate.
Cast Shadowburn when available, and if you are about to cap on soul shards
Cast Chaos Bolt to avoid capping soul shards
Cast Chaos Bolt if you have more than 4 soul shards and Infernal Bolt ready
Soul Fire when available, and you have less than 4 soul shards
Cast Conflagrate to keep this below 2 stacks or when moving
Cast Conflagrate to generate soul shards and generate Backdraft stacks. Try to use these on Chaos Bolt as much as possible.
Cast Incinerate to generate soul shards
